skill.name: decision-action
skill.description: Guides decisions by comparing options, stating tradeoffs, and making a clear recommendation.
skill.summary: Choose, prioritize, or make go/no-go decisions with explicit tradeoff analysis.
skill.author: BellaBe

security_audit.summary: Static analysis found no suspicious patterns in the single prompt-only skill file. Manual review found no prompt injection, data exfiltration intent, or executable behavior.

content.value_statement: Teams often stall when options have unclear tradeoffs. This skill guides Claude, Codex, or Claude Code to compare options, recommend one, and define revisit triggers.
actual_capabilities: Defines the decision in clear terms before comparing options.
Lists realistic options and includes no action when relevant.
Compares options against explicit decision criteria.
Makes a clear recommendation instead of staying neutral.
States risks, tradeoffs, and conditions that should reopen the decision.
limitations: It does not execute plans after the decision is made.
It does not replace legal, financial, medical, or safety review.
Its recommendation depends on the quality of user-provided criteria.
It is not designed for open-ended advice without a firm choice.

use_cases.title: Prioritize Product Work
use_cases.description: Compare feature options by impact, cost, risk, and urgency, then choose the next item to build.

use_cases.title: Make Technical Tradeoffs
use_cases.description: Select an implementation path by weighing complexity, maintainability, delivery time, and operational risk.

use_cases.title: Decide Go Or No-Go
use_cases.description: Review readiness signals, risks, and fallback conditions before approving a launch or delaying it.

prompt_templates.title: Choose Between Options
prompt_templates.prompt: Use decision-action to choose between these options: [option A], [option B], and [option C]. Compare them by [criteria]. Recommend one choice.

prompt_templates.title: Prioritize A Backlog
prompt_templates.prompt: Use decision-action to prioritize this list: [items]. Include no action if relevant. Compare impact, effort, risk, and urgency.

prompt_templates.title: Make A Go/No-Go Call
prompt_templates.prompt: Use decision-action for a go/no-go decision on [initiative]. Review readiness, blockers, risks, benefits, and revisit triggers.

prompt_templates.title: Resolve A Complex Tradeoff
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced decision with competing stakeholder goals.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use decision-action to decide [decision]. Include stakeholder priorities, decision criteria, weighted tradeoffs, risk mitigations, and conditions that would change the recommendation.

output_examples.input: Choose whether to ship today, delay one week, or cancel a small release.
output_examples.output: Recommendation: delay one week. The release has value, but unresolved quality risks outweigh the schedule benefit. Revisit after the blocking tests pass.

output_examples.input: Prioritize three projects when the team has capacity for one.
output_examples.output: Recommendation: choose the billing cleanup project first. It has the strongest customer impact, lowest delivery risk, and clear success criteria.

output_examples.input: Decide whether to build in-house tooling or buy a managed service.
output_examples.output: Recommendation: buy the managed service. It reduces maintenance load and speeds delivery, while the main tradeoff is lower customization.

best_practices: Provide the decision, options, constraints, and success criteria upfront.
State which criteria matter most before asking for a recommendation.
Ask for revisit triggers when the decision depends on changing facts.
anti_patterns: Do not use it when you need a step-by-step execution plan.
Do not ask for a neutral overview if a firm choice is required.
Do not hide important constraints or stakeholder priorities.

faq.question: What does this skill help with?
faq.answer: It helps choose among options by comparing criteria, tradeoffs, risks, and revisit triggers.

faq.question: Does it make a firm recommendation?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill is designed to choose one option and explain the reason.

faq.question: Can it include a no-action option?
faq.answer: Yes. The source skill instructs the assistant to include no action when it is relevant.

faq.question: Is it useful for prioritization?
faq.answer: Yes. It can compare competing work and recommend what should come first.

faq.question: Can it create an execution plan?
faq.answer: No. The skill explicitly directs execution plans to a separate planning action.

faq.question: Does it use external tools or code?
faq.answer: No. It is a prompt-only skill with no scripts, network calls, or filesystem actions.
